_source: Shape of a v1 Engine as Longhorn v1.13.0 stores it, built from Longhorn's own code at tag v1.13.0:
https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/k8s/pkg/apis/longhorn/v1beta2/engine.go (Engine spec embeds InstanceSpec, status embeds InstanceStatus)

https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/k8s/pkg/apis/longhorn/v1beta2/instancemanager.go (InstanceSpec json keys volumeName, nodeID, desireState, dataEngine, image; InstanceStatus json keys ownerID, instanceManagerName, currentState; InstanceStateRunning = "running")
Names, uids and timestamps are placeholders.
